annotations.text:
Floodlight, light by default.
The chrome stays night-dark and the body is lit paper — the direction is the contrast between the two, not a palette that flips wholesale. So the dark artboard beside it moves only the body, and the toggle costs the app nothing structural.
Built on Matchweek's real tokens. No Premier League branding — same genre, original design.

The accent does two jobs.

As a FILL it stays the lime, always on ink text — it reads on paper and on slate alike, so buttons, the active tab and the 'yours' row need no light/dark variant.

As INK it darkens to a deep grass green so it can carry text on paper: links, positive numbers, the countdown.

Spin the accent chip above this artboard and both track together.
Hover the first specimen in each row — it's live. The rest are pinned so the states sit side by side.
The two directions not taken, kept for reference. Both are still in their original dark treatment — they were never carried through to light.
